Package com.hkust.marketplace.repositories

Class DealRepository

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.DealRepository
public class DealRepository extends Object
Database access for deals (offers / borrow requests / claims) between a buyer and a seller.

Creates PENDING proposals and stores explicit proposal/deal lifecycle states. Callers must authorize reads in the service layer; repository filters are not authorization.

    • findBuyerHistory

      public List<DealHistoryEntry> findBuyerHistory(String username) throws SQLException
      Returns the buyer's closed deals (COMPLETED or RETURNED) with review data for the history screen.

      Uses a new connection. Each entry carries the listing title/category, seller username and full name (possibly null after a permanent user deletion), the close time (returnedDate, else completedDate), the stored deal type and status, the agreed terms, and the review rating/comment/seller reply plus its hidden flag (hidden reviews are included). Rows are not filtered by the deleted counter, and no identifier validation is performed.

      Parameters:
      username - the buyer's username
      Returns:
      closed deals for the buyer, newest close time first; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails or a stored deal type/status is unknown

    • findAffectedDeals

      public List<Deal> findAffectedDeals(String listingId) throws SQLException
      Preview the deals affected by a listing change. With the current schema all pending/countered/accepted records are affected, including ongoing borrowing. This does not mean they can all be cancelled: the service must decide which changes are allowed. Terminal history (DECLINED, COMPLETED, RETURNED, CANCELLED) is excluded.

      Uses a new connection and does not lock; see findAffectedDeals(Connection, String) for the recheck applied inside a transaction. Rows with deleted = 2 are excluded.

      Parameters:
      listingId - the listing ID
      Returns:
      the open (PENDING/COUNTERED/ACCEPTED) deals, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the listing ID is blank or longer than 50 code points
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findAffectedDeals

      public List<Deal> findAffectedDeals(Connection connection, String listingId) throws SQLException
      Recheck affected deals when applying a confirmed listing change. The caller owns this transaction and must authorize the action, apply changes, and commit or roll back. Lock the listing first, matching create(), so a concurrent create cannot add a deal between this check and the listing update. A confirmation preview alone must never authorize cancellation of new deals.

      The listing row is locked with FOR UPDATE first, then the open deals are read with FOR UPDATE. The caller owns the connection and its commit/rollback.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      listingId - the listing whose open deals are rechecked
      Returns:
      the locked open (PENDING/COUNTERED/ACCEPTED) deals with deleted < 2, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional, the listing ID is invalid, or the listing does not exist
      SQLException - when the queries fail

    • searchDeals

      public List<Deal> searchDeals(String keyword, ListingType type, String status, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) throws SQLException
      Optional filters; created-date bounds are inclusive. Keyword is literal text.

      Uses a new connection. The keyword is matched with LOCATE against the listing title, buyer username, seller username and deal ID (case sensitivity follows the database collation); blank/null filters are ignored. type is mapped to the stored deal type and status to a known DealStatus name (case-insensitive). Rows with deleted = 2 are excluded.

      Parameters:
      keyword - literal text to find, or null/blank for no keyword filter
      type - the listing type to match, or null for all types
      status - the deal status name to match, or null/blank for all statuses
      from - inclusive earliest created date, or null for unbounded
      to - inclusive latest created date, or null for unbounded
      Returns:
      matching deals, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when from is after to or status is not a known deal status
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • create

      public String create(Deal deal) throws SQLException
      Persist a new PENDING proposal. Does not perform acceptance, listing reservation, notification, or chat transitions. The service must authenticate the buyer before calling this method.

      Opens and commits its own transaction. The generated/returned ID, canonical seller, PENDING status, row version and creation time are written back onto the deal.

      Parameters:
      deal - the proposal to insert
      Returns:
      the new deal's ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the proposal is null or invalid (status not PENDING, bad price, bad borrow period, already countered/completed, or the buyer/listing/seller eligibility checks fail)
      SQLException - when the insert fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • create

      public String create(Connection connection, Deal deal) throws SQLException
      Insert a proposal within the caller's deal/notification transaction.

      The caller owns the connection and commit/rollback. The buyer, listing and seller are validated on the same transaction, the listing is locked with FOR UPDATE, and a second accepted deal for the listing is rejected. The deal's ID, canonical seller, PENDING status, row version (1) and creation time are set on the object.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      deal - the proposal to insert
      Returns:
      the new deal's ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional or the proposal is invalid
      SQLException - when the insert fails

      Returns:

      SQLException - when the queries fail

    • updateStatus

      public boolean updateStatus(Connection connection, String id, DealStatus expected, long expectedVersion, DealStatus next, LocalDateTime occurredAt) throws SQLException
      Guarded lifecycle write. Caller authenticates/authorizes the actor and owns the transaction, including related listing updates and notification delivery. Pass the row version shown to the actor. False means the deal disappeared or its status/terms changed since that read; reload instead of silently retrying.

      The deal and its listing are re-read with FOR UPDATE; on success the guarded update advances row_version, stores the completion/return time, and, when accepting a counter, adopts the counter terms while retaining the counter history.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; caller owns it
      id - the deal ID
      expected - the status the actor saw; must allow the transition to next
      expectedVersion - the row_version the actor saw
      next - the target status; COUNTERED must be written through updateProposal(Connection, String, DealStatus, long, Double, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime)
      occurredAt - the action time stored for completion or return
      Returns:
      true when the guarded update matched the expected status and version and was applied; false when the deal disappeared or changed since the read
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional, the transition is not allowed, the timestamp precedes creation, completion/return does not match the deal type, return precedes borrowing, or acceptance validation fails
      SQLException - when any statement fails

    • updateProposal

      public boolean updateProposal(Connection connection, String id, DealStatus expected, long expectedVersion, Double counterPrice, LocalDateTime counterStart, LocalDateTime counterEnd) throws SQLException
      Seller counteroffer; stale versions return false. Authorization and commit belong to the service.

      The deal and its listing are re-read with FOR UPDATE. On success the deal becomes COUNTERED with the supplied terms and an incremented row_version; a giveaway claim can never be countered. The caller owns the connection and transaction.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; caller owns it
      id - the deal ID
      expected - the status the seller saw (PENDING or COUNTERED)
      expectedVersion - the row_version the seller saw
      counterPrice - the counter sale price for a sale, or null for borrowing
      counterStart - the counter borrowing start, required for borrowing
      counterEnd - the counter borrowing due time, required for borrowing
      Returns:
      true when the guarded update matched and was applied; false when the deal disappeared or changed since the read
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional, the status is not counterable, the terms do not match the deal type, or a giveaway is countered
      SQLException - when any statement fails
